checks.explanation: The observed and sign_changed cases use their actual delivered signs: observed reports soft_mass positive and local_dy/local_cyy/local_cxx negative at landmark_00, while sign_changed reports the reversed signs (soft_mass negative, local_cyy/local_cxx positive) with correspondingly reversed positive_batch_fraction values. Interpretation changes with the sign flip rather than being copied across cases.

The missing case delivers no regional_effects rows and prerequisites.selection_contrasts=false; its response makes no enrichment or signed-contrast claim, only objective, label-bound contrast definition, and clock metadata, with limitations stating no per-node contrast values were delivered.

The A and nm cases are treated as the same physical scale with a tenfold unit conversion (quantiles 0.4455/0.8628/1.0496 A vs 0.04455/0.08628/0.10496 nm). Both retain the incumbent, cite only clock metadata, and state no spatial-scale or dispersion observation was delivered, so no unit-inconsistent edit is made.
